audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagreed with the audited mirror, and whys[0] said 'You win level 1' on a row already marked Skill.
audit.why: sylas__yorick.json now reads Skill / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas / Yorick on disk. Sylas holds the whole laning phase on Kingslayer's healing and Abscond's mobility; Yorick takes it back only at two items.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings inverse to the mirror, and whys[0] rewritten to argue Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed 'his ult value is low here' because Eulogy is not a burst ultimate.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s and lets Sylas cast the stolen ultimate freely — against Yorick that means a second Maiden of the Mist, at rank 1 on half the cooldown of Eulogy's 160s. Whether the stolen Maiden is weak is not in Riot's text; what is in the text is that he gets one and gets it back twice as often.
audit.corrected: Hijack is 80s at rank 1 against Eulogy's 160s and it takes your ultimate — do not ult first into an even fight.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond / Abduct is described as 'his dash + stun (recast pull)' in three fields. Riot's text has no stun on it. Kingslayer, the ability that actually decides this lane, is mentioned only as 'heal stabilizes his trading'.
audit.why: Riot's E text: Sylas dashes to a location and can recast to throw his chains, pulling himself to an enemy he hits — a reposition, not crowd control, on 13/12/11/10/9s. Kingslayer is a 400-range lunge on 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s that heals him against enemy champions, dropping to a 6-second cooldown by rank 5, which is why chip damage alone never finishes him and why Grievous Wounds timing is the matchup.
audit.corrected: Abduct pulls him to you and applies no stun. Kingslayer heals off champions every 12s at rank 1, down to 6s — buy Grievous Wounds before his first AP item.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Sylas so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1 — a dash out and a recast pull back in, no stun, so he picks the range. - Kingslayer (12s) heals off champions; Grievous Wounds is not optional here. - Hijack: 80s, and it takes Eulogy.

notes: The 'dash + stun' description of Abscond / Abduct repeated across breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and dosFull[0]; Riot's text carries no crowd control on it, and telling the player to wait for a stun that does not exist made them refuse trades they could take. The claim that Hijack 'gains little value' from Eulogy was an unsupported strength judgement and is replaced with what the kit actually says: 80s versus 160s, and he gets your Maiden.
